pose: An expansive landscape composition showcasing a diverse, historically accurate Jurassic ecosystem arranged across distinct spatial layers. Set within a lush forest valley filled with massive, stylized conifer tree blocks, ancient ginkgos, and thick patches of low-lying primitive ferns beneath a bright blue sky with soft, puffy white clouds. In the immediate foreground, clinging to a textured tree trunk, a small, bird-like gliding theropod (Yi qi) is shown in a sharp profile view, its membranous, bat-like wings partially extended as if preparing to launch. In the midground near a wide, winding riverbank, a heavily armored stegosaur (Stegosaurus) browses on low foliage, highlighting its prominent dorsal plates and spiked tail. Further back in the river valley, a towering sauropod (Brachiosaurus) stands majestically, its long neck extending into the upper canopy. Watching over the valley from a distant, sun-drenched rocky ridge in the background, the powerful, commanding silhouette of an apex large theropod (Allosaurus) monitors the entire active scene.
